name: UndergroundVentilationGasLog
tagline: Know which headings are safe to enter – gas readings, TARP limits, post-blast re-entry and heat stress in one Power Platform app.
description: A complete underground ventilation and gas monitoring log for Power Apps and Power Pages: record O2, CO, NO2, H2S, CH4, air velocity and wet/dry bulb readings by level and heading, see every heading's condition on a live board, enforce the post-blast re-entry wait and test, manage exceedances through TARP actions to a verified close-out and track heat stress bands. Works instantly in demo mode and connects to collections, Dataverse, SharePoint or SQL in a few clicks. Decision-support log only – not a certified gas detection or alarm system.
features: TARP trigger and exceedance levels per reading
Heading condition: No entry, Re-entry pending, Caution, Overdue, Clear
Post-blast re-entry countdown and test enforcement
Exceedance workflow with TARP action chips and compliant follow-up close-out
Wet bulb heat bands with configurable guidance
Bulk verify / void, CSV export, undo
Configurable limits, wait times, intervals, labels and colours
Phone, tablet and desktop layouts; keyboard and screen-reader support
Power Fx outputs and events (OnSelect, OnChange, OnCreate, OnSave, OnAction, OnStatusChange)
pack: Niray Mining & Natural Resources PCF Pack
react: 16.14.0 bundled (no platform library, no Fluent UI)
controlType: standard (2 controls: dataset + Power Pages field control)
